description: This file implements TLS pinning and fingerprint management for a WebSocket session, including keychain storage, migration from UserDefaults, and server trust challenge handling.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: Manages a WebSocket session with custom TLS trust evaluation and fingerprint handling.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads a stored TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID, migrating from UserDefaults if needed.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves a TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes a stored fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task with a specified URL and sets maximum message size.

methods.name: urlSession:didReceive:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles server trust challenge, verifying server certificate fingerprint, and deciding whether to trust or cancel.
